question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Out of the woods
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Out of the woods"** means no longer in trouble or difficulty. (मुसीबत से बाहर) • **Example: **After the successful surgery, the patient is finally out of the woods. • **"No longer in trouble"** refers to a situation where someone has overcome or escaped a difficult or dangerous situation. (अब और मुसीबत में नहीं) • **Example: **With the project finally completed, the team is no longer in trouble. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **No longer young** (अब युवा नहीं): Refers to someone who is no longer in their youth. • **Example:** Though he is no longer young, he remains active and healthy. • **No longer famous** (अब प्रसिद्ध नहीं): Refers to someone who has lost their fame or popularity. • **Example:** The actor is no longer famous and now leads a quiet life. • **No longer in sight** (अब दृष्टि में नहीं): Refers to something or someone that is no longer visible. • **Example:** The ship sailed away and was soon no longer in sight. 133:Tde5, ਸਹੀ ਜਵਾਬ ਹੈ: **ਵਿਕਲਪ 1**।
